name: Borrowed Visage
text:
Whenever a creature you control is turned face up, you may exile a creature card from your hand face down. You may look at cards exiled with Borrowed Visage.
{2}{U}, {T}: You may reveal a card exiled with Borrowed Visage. If you do, target creature you control becomes a copy of the revealed card until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
